args.title: Brightline cold-chain series — combined summary
args.body:
Combined summary of https://blog.brightline.example/2026/cold-chain and its companion piece (https://insights.brightline.example/cold-chain/companion):

• Temperature excursions fell 30% in 2026 where carriers shared live sensor data.
• Most savings came from fewer rejected loads, not from reduced spoilage.
• Companion piece: pilots cut claims by a quarter.
